title: Reese's Sodium Options Chinese Translation
description: An unofficial Chiness translation pack for Reese's Sodium Options's config screen
body:
This resource pack translations the new config screen of Reese's Sodium Options to Chinese.
此资源包将Reese的钠视频界面的新版配置界面翻译为中文。

The pack is compatible with **Sodium 0.8+** and **Reese's Sodium Options 2.0+**.
此包与 **钠 0.8以上版本** 和 **Reese的钠视频界面 2.0以上版本** 兼容。

It is **LITERALLY** made by myself. If you want to discuss with me, add my QQ:3454310856.
此包**完全**由我制作。想和我讨论译名，加我QQ:3454310856。

If there's a mod or a resource pack witch doing my works, I will give up this program.
如果有模组或者资源包做了翻译，我直接就是跑路了。
